claims.subject: Phase 2 counting trigger algorithm
claims.evidence_quote: In this, each candidate processor sends the message to other candidate processors via referee processors as they encounter a trigger.

claims.subject: Candidate Processor
claims.evidence_quote: Recall that each candidate processor samples 2(n ln n∕α)1∕2 referee processors independently and uniformly among n processors.

claims.subject: Candidate Processor
claims.evidence_quote: The candidate processors raise an alert when the number of triggers reaches w1 and the algorithm terminates.

claims.subject: Committee Processor
claims.evidence_quote: Correctness. The alert is triggered once the count reaches the specified threshold, provided that committee processors monitor the trigger count and at least one non-faulty processor exists within the committee.

claims.subject: Lemma 5
claims.evidence_quote: Lemma 5. Any pair of candidate processors has at least one common nonfaulty referee processor with high probability.
